title: What stays when six negative tokens leave four positive ones?
description: Four positive tokens sit on a tray, but six negative tokens must be taken away and there are none. Six zero pairs are put out so the six negative tokens can be lifted off, and ten positive tokens stay. Keeko thinks taking away a negative number must make the value smaller.
teaching_notes: One idea: to take away negative tokens that are not there, put out one zero pair for each, then take the negative tokens away. Watch for students who think taking away a negative number lowers the value.

source: Example: +4 - (-6). Start with 4 positives. We have to take out 6 negatives from these. But there are not enough negatives. Add some zero pairs: we have to take away 6 negatives so we put down 6 zero pairs. Now we can take away 6 negatives.
video_script.why: The child subtracts negative tokens that are not on the tray by putting out one zero pair for each, and sees that the value goes up.
video_script.substitution: Put out one zero pair for each negative token to take away, lift off the negative tokens, and read the answer from the tokens that stay.
video_script.anchor: a tray of four positive tokens
video_script.wrong_move: thinks that taking away a negative number must make the value smaller than the start
video_script.payoff_line: Positive four take away negative six leaves positive ten.
never_show: a value below four as the answer
maths_rules: (+4) is 4 positive tokens; 6 negative tokens must be taken out, but none are on the tray
each zero pair holds 1 negative token, so 6 zero pairs give 6 negative tokens; the value stays 4
the tray now holds 4 + 6 = 10 positive tokens and 6 negative tokens
take out the 6 negative tokens: 10 positive tokens stay, so (+4) − (−6) = +10
slip: taking away negative tokens raises the value, from 4 to 10
video_script.design: One idea: put out one zero pair for each negative token to take away, then lift the negative tokens off. Positive tokens are green and negative tokens are red as in the book. Keeko's doubt is that taking away a negative number makes the value smaller.
